source: PDB entry 1AON, 'Crystal structure of the asymmetric chaperonin complex GroEL/GroES/(ADP)7' (Xu, Horwich & Sigler, Nature 1997, 388:741-750), from https://files.rcsb.org/download/1AON.cif, fetched 2026-11-21 (SHA-256 6b202f340ffb9a1924d5315ce9e837e02cee1dbd745df675be76f6d4e1b8e66f); RCSB PDB releases its coordinate files under CC0 1.0.
